crossRefs.note: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son…
Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and…
Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.
His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who…
Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;
On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

people.name: Asaph
people.line: Levite musician, psalmist, and ancestor of temple singers

people.name: Berechiah
people.line: Levite musician and gatekeeper in David's time

people.name: Heman
people.line: A Levite and chief musician in David's time.

people.name: Jeduthun
people.line: Levitical musician and singer during David's reign

people.name: Joel
people.line: Samuel's firstborn son who judged Israel

people.name: Kishi
people.line: A Levite and father of Jeduthun (or 'Ethan')

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

translations.web: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
translations.bsb: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; from his brothers, Asaph son of Berechiah; from their brothers the Merarites, Ethan son of Kushaiah;
translations.kjv: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
